{{Infobox character |image =Kuvalda FactoryBoss Screenshot.png |image size = |faction =[[Scavs]] |full name =Unknown |location =[[Factory]], [[Interchange]], [[Terminal]] |origin = |spawn chance = }} '''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a Scav [[Boss]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''. ==Biography== People fear Tagilla far beyond the walls of Polikhim Plant #16. Some managed to flee the Factory after hearing his roar. But no one has ever survived his sledgehammer. Veterans still remember how Tagilla toyed with the PMC squads who dared to explore The Labyrinth beneath the health resort. ==Notes== * Tagilla has different health values than PMCs and Scavs. {|class="wikitable" !Tagilla's Health !Stats |- ![[File:Health_Tagilla.png|460px]] |Head: 100 Thorax: 320 Stomach: 260 Arms: 130 each Legs: 140 each '''Total: 1220''' |} * Instead of the typical 4 single slot pockets, he has 5 triple slot pockets, bringing their total space to 15 slots. ==Quests== * Tagilla needs to be killed once each for the quests [[The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief]] and [[The Huntsman Path - Relentless]]. ==Location== Tagilla can be found on the following locations: ====[[Factory]]==== Has to be expected everywhere. ====[[Interchange]]==== In the parking garage below the Goshan store.
  • File:TagillaInterchangeMap.jpg|Location marked on map
    • ====[[Terminal]]==== In the medium container ship berths area. '''Note:''' Tagilla is only 1 of 5 possible bosses to spawn each raid.
  • File:Terminal Bosses Map.jpg|Location marked on map
    • ==Behavior== He is batshit insane and will attempt to hammer you down. However, if you are in a position that he cannot path-find to, such as the rafters, he will use his secondary weapon (usually a shotgun) to kill you from a distance. He's active immediately at the start of raid. The boss can set ambushes, open suppressive fire, and breach if needed. ==Strategy== If you are using high penetrating ammunition, aim for his head, not his thorax. If you have low pen or high flesh damage, aim for his stomach since his armor only covers the thorax. Tagillas welding masks do not protect his nape, therefore you can try to shoot him there. This strategy requires sneaking up behind him without you being detected, or a teammate that flanks him while he is fighting or chasing you. ==Equipment== Note that the primary weapons can have numerous mod variations and those shown below are examples.

    • ==Trivia== *Tagilla is the younger brother of [[Killa]], the boss on the [[Interchange]] location. *According to [[Jaeger]] in [[The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief]], Tagilla is a former employee of the Chemical Plant No. 16, which is the [[Factory]] location. *According to [[Jaeger]] in [[The Huntsman Path - Factory Chief]], Tagilla's custom welding masks are inspired by Killa's [[Maska-1SCh bulletproof helmet (Killa Edition)|custom Maska-1SCh helmet]]. *Russia has the Tagil river and the city of Nizhny Tagil, which became famous thanks to the meme "Tagil rulit" in the Russian part of the internet. Briefly: The meme indicates indecent behavior while intoxicated. **Given this, and Tagilla's status as a worker at the Factory where [[TerraGroup]] was producing chemicals for drug research, it is possible that Tagilla's aggressive behavior and extreme physical toughness is caused by him being exposed to or otherwise under the influence of experimental drugs. * Tagilla is voiced by Russian actor [https://kupigolos.ru/diktory/zharkov-ivan Ivan Zharkov]. The same actor voices Thor in the Marvel films. Tagilla, like Thor, uses a hammer. ** Interestingly, in November 2025, Ivan Zharkov wrote "Buyanov won" in his Telegram channel and posted a photo of his Steam library. Ivan had purchased EFT and started downloading the game. However, a few days later, he wrote "Refund" and explained that he had issued a refund for the Steam version of the game. He allegedly couldn't access the game. However, Ivan still had the game he had purchased on the official BSG website.https://ixbt.games/news/2025/11/17/golos-tagilly-nasel-bystryi-sposob-sbezat-iz-tarkova-vernul-dengi-za-escape-from-tarkov-v-steam.html {{Navbox bosses}} [[Category:Bosses]] [[cs:Tagilla]] [[ru:Тагилла]] [[fr:Tagilla]]
